uutiset.t: Commerzbank Weighs Partial Withdrawal From US Treasury Market
uutiset.s: Commerzbank AG is considering paring back its involvement in US Treasury trading, according to people with knowledge of the matter, as the US prepares to introduce new Treasury clearing requirements.

uutiset.t: Compass Plans New York Main Listing, Adding to London Exodus
uutiset.s: British catering firm Compass Group Plc plans to move its primary listing from London to New York, adding to the struggles of the UK stock market.

Copper Rally Fades as Demand Worries Deepen
uutiset.s: Copper erased a one-day gain sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. Prices tumbled back toward the $12,000-a-ton level in London. Bloomberg's Mark Cranfield breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Emerging Market Stocks Rally as Huang’s Return Revives AI Trade
uutiset.s: Emerging-market stocks rallied the most since July as investors snapped up artificial intelligence shares after Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp.

uutiset.t: South Korea Considers Potential $3 Billion Dollar Bond Sale
uutiset.s: South Korea is considering issuing potentially about $3 billion of dollar-denominated notes in January.

uutiset.t: China Warns Huang Comeback Doesn’t End ‘Malicious’ Risks From US
uutiset.s: Jensen Huang’s return to the helm of Nvidia Corp. restores the AI industry’s most prominent opponent of chip controls against China. Already, Beijing has signaled it sees little reason to expect Washington’s restrictions to ease.

uutiset.t: Singapore, China Deepen Yuan Ties With Focus on Corporates
uutiset.s: The central banks of Singapore and China will expand ways for financial institutions to access yuan funding in the city-state to help finance a broader range of corporate activities, in another step to promote the currency’s international use.

uutiset.t: Treasuries Advance as Cheaper Oil Alleviates Inflation Concerns
uutiset.s: US Treasuries gained across the curve as a drop in oil prices eased concerns about inflation, a notable move on a day when Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. revived investor appetite for risk assets.

uutiset.t: Goldman Says Won Stability Beats Rate Hikes in Cooling Inflation
uutiset.s: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. said stabilizing South Korea’s currency would be a more effective way to curb inflation than raising interest rates, arguing that price pressures stem more from rising import costs than from strong domestic demand.

uutiset.t: MSCI Says No Change in Indonesia Market Consultation Process
uutiset.s: US index compiler MSCI Inc. said Tuesday that it hadn’t changed its process for considering a downgrade of Indonesia’s stock-market status, a day after Bloomberg reported news of a meeting between the company’s chief executive and President Prabowo Subianto.

uutiset.t: Chinese Cobalt Producer Shares Jump as Congo Set to Ban Exports
uutiset.s: Shares in Chinese cobalt producers surged after the Democratic Republic of Congo slapped an export ban on the battery metal from the end of the month in a bid to arrest a price decline.

uutiset.t: Copper Erases Brief Nvidia Bounce on Demand and Rate Concerns
uutiset.s: Copper erased a one-day gain sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp., with prices tumbling back toward the $12,000-a-ton level in London as demand and interest-rate concerns returned to the fore.
